source_trigger_snapshots.deploy-vps.yml:
name: Deploy VPS

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    # harness 的状态类改动不触发部署/CI。装了 harness 之后，状态机每推进一个阶段就会
    # 提交一次 progress.json —— 没有这张表的话，每一次状态推进都会重建镜像并部署生产。
    paths-ignore:
      - ".auto-memory/**"
      - ".claude/**"
      - "framework/**"
      # docs/ 全目录豁免的成立前提：运行时代码不读取 docs/（已 grep 核实 src/ app/ 零命中，
      # 引用见 docs/adr/0001）。若未来有运行时资产进 docs/，必须先收窄本行。
      - "docs/**"
      - "progress.json"
      - "features.json"
      - "backlog.json"
      - ".agents-registry.json"
      - "harness.json"
      - "harness.lock"
      - "harness-rules.md"
      - "planner.md"
      - "generator.md"
      - "evaluator.md"
      - "orchestration-patterns.md"
      - "CLAUDE.md"
      - "AGENTS.md"
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      operation:
        description: Release gates/deploy, or read-only scoped host inventory
        required: true
        type: choice
        options: [release, host-preflight]
        default: release
      predecessor_sha:
        description: Optional distinct prior source SHA; defaults to fetched origin/main
        required: false
        type: string
      bootstrap_rehearsal:
        description: Explicit first-baseline same-SHA rehearsal only; disables production deployment
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false

concurrency:
  group: deploy-vps
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  host-preflight:
    name: Read-only tokenizer host inventory
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.operation == 'host-preflight'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
source_trigger_snapshots.contract-conformance.yml:
name: Contract Conformance

# BL-REPO-MECH F002：双仓契约一致性守门。
# checkout harness-template @ harness.json 钉住的框架 commit，对其 contract-fixtures
# 跑双向契约测试（tests/contract/）。协议改动的 Deploy VPS verify 也会跑
# 相同的锁定契约测试并阻止失败部署；本工作流保留独立可观察的契约结果。

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - src/server/harness-*
      - src/cli/harness*
      - src/shared/harness*
      - app/api/harness/**
      - .claude/console/**
      - harness.json
      - prisma/schema.prisma
      - prisma/migrations/**
      - tests/contract/**
      - scripts/ci/assert-vitest-results.mjs
      - .github/workflows/contract-conformance.yml
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - src/server/harness-*
      - src/cli/harness*
      - src/shared/harness*
      - app/api/harness/**
      - .claude/console/**
      - harness.json
      - prisma/schema.prisma
      - prisma/migrations/**
      - tests/contract/**
      - scripts/ci/assert-vitest-results.mjs
      - .github/workflows/contract-conformance.yml
  workflow_dispatch: {}
source_trigger_snapshots.windows-release-diagnostics.yml:
name: Windows release diagnostics

'on':
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches:
      - codex/windows-native-diagnostic-ci-20261008

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: windows-release-diagnostics-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  native-diagnostics:
    name: Read-only native Windows diagnosis
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/codex/windows-native-diagnostic-ci-20261008'
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 12
    steps:
      - name: Checkout immutable diagnostic commit
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 1
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Setup Node.js 22
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'

      - name: Record minimal native provenance
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
source_trigger_snapshots.windows-p1-stages-diagnostic.yml:
name: Windows P1 INITIAL diagnostic

on:
  push:
    branches: [codex/windows-p1-stages-ci-20261010]

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: windows-p1-initial-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  p1-initial-diagnostic:
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/codex/windows-p1-stages-ci-20261010'
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 12
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        env:
          GIT_CONFIG_COUNT: '2'
          GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0: core.longpaths
          GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0: 'true'
          GIT_CONFIG_KEY_1: core.autocrlf
          GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_1: 'false'
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 1
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
      - name: Prepare exact-candidate provenance
        run: node docs/test-reports/windows-p1-stages-20261010/p1-stages.mjs --prepare
      - name: Install locked dependencies
        run: npm ci
      - name: Synthetic checks only
